name: footer
title: Footer
purpose: Close an application with brand context, grouped links, and optional contact or social information.
accessibility: Uses a semantic footer and labeled navigation landmark with native links.
External social links receive accessible names and noreferrer protection.
The linked brand image or text title requires a meaningful accessible name.
commonMistakes: Assuming the navigation always has exactly three sections.
Publishing placeholder contact information as real data.
Using decorative icon-only links without accessible names.
examples: Footer with contacts and social links
